name: dictation-refiner
description: 语音听写文本润色：把 ASR 语音识别结果整理成清楚、自然、可插入的最终文字（补标点、去口头词、修正同音词、保留术语大小写），复刻自开源项目 Cindy 的 dictation-refinement 功能。
description_en: Speech dictation refiner: cleans up ASR transcription into clear, natural, insert-ready text (punctuation, filler removal, homophone fixes, term casing preservation). Ported from the open-source Cindy project.
